title: How to Build a Startup Without Funding by Pieter Levels @ Dojo Bali
summary: Pieter Levels talks at Dojo Bali about building startups without venture capital through bootstrapping, persistence and learning many skills as a generalist. He reviews his own past projects.
why: Pointed to as an inspiring talk for solo makers turning side projects into profitable businesses.

quote.text: Probably the best startup talk I've seen in a while.
